summary: POST /orders refuses a totalMinor above 10 000 000 (100 000.00) with 400; the maximum itself is accepted.

acceptance.text: POST /orders with totalMinor 10000001 answers 400 and stores no order
POST /orders with totalMinor 10000000 answers 201 with the order
POST /orders still refuses totalMinor 0 or 10.5 (400) and an unknown user (422)

tasks.title: maximum order total on POST /orders
steps: In test/orders.e2e-spec.ts add "POST /orders accepts a total at the maximum" and "POST /orders rejects a total above the maximum and stores nothing". The second fails now: 10000001 is accepted
Run npm run test:e2e -- orders: red
In src/orders/orders.dto.ts add MAX_TOTAL_MINOR = 10_000_000 and @Max(MAX_TOTAL_MINOR) on CreateOrderDto.totalMinor, maximum in its @ApiProperty
Update the POST /orders row in README.md
Run npm run test:e2e -- orders: green

facts: src/app.module.ts: a global ValidationPipe (transform, whitelist) answers 400 on a DTO violation
test/orders.e2e-spec.ts: 'POST /orders rejects a non-positive or non-integer total' covers the lower bound

decisions.text: The maximum is 10 000 000 minor units, inclusive
